system.flavor:
Throw a brawler across the room, flip a man over a table, toss someone into a cart bed, or put a struggling prisoner on the ground and keep them there.

Not enough to throw anyone off a roof or lift anything heavier than a person.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Bludgeoning Damage, move the target to an empty space within 2 units of you and knock it Prone.

surges.html: The target may land 1 unit farther away.
Deal +1 Damage if it was already Prone or Slowed.

rider.title: Combo - Finisher
rider.html: After a hit, spend 2 Combo to pin the target's position: until your next turn, standing from Prone costs it 2 burned dice rather than 1.
